messages:
Alex: Okay not a drill — finance just confirmed we closed $10M ARR 🎉🥂
Priya: WHAAAAT!!! :seltzer: :tada:
Sam: omg neon socks and a confetti cannon when? :joy:
Jordan: 4pm in the kitchen for a 5-minute slice-of-life photo. marketing wants candid shots.
Evelyn: I can bring sparkling water + gluten-free cupcakes. also learned a fun chant for this...
Vik: I'll grab the tiny gongs. also ordering extra stickers for the lobby.
Alex: love it. quick ask: keep it low-key for remote folks — livestreaming the toast room?
Priya: yes! setting up a little Zoom from my laptop, will post link in #random 10 min before.
Sam: huge shoutout to infra (Vik) and runtime (Jordan) — 0 incidents during the last push 🙌 :heart:
Vik: team effort, but will accept a ceremonial high-five and the neon socks as tribute.
Jordan: also shoutout to Evelyn's eval set that caught the hallucination regression. saved us a bunch.
Evelyn: blushing. also free cupcakes for people who show up in socks.
DeployBot: Deployment notice: perks-service v3.2 -> prod at 1911110025 (no rollback). :white_check_mark:
Alex: DeployBot says it's stable. perfect timing.
Priya: Poll: confetti cannon or biodegradable confetti poppers? React with :1: for cannon, :2: for poppers.
Sam: :2: (neighbors are dogs)
Jordan: :1: (team chaos)
Evelyn: :2: (clean up is real)
Vik: :1: (I live for chaos)
Alex: Everyone — THANK YOU. sweating and smiling. quick toast script for 4pm: 30s thank you -> 30s team cheer -> group photo. See you there! :raised_hands:
